newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mitsui High-tech up on profit forecast report.
newsitem.headline: Mitsui High-tech up on profit forecast report.

text.p: Shares of Mitsui High-tec Inc rose on the Tokyo Stock Exchange (TSE) on Monday afternoon due to a newspaper report that the company was expected to post a larger parent current profit in the year to January 31, 1997, than initially forecast.
MItsui High-tech was up 120 yen at 2,390 by 0349 GMT.

Japanese business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun reported over the weekend that the company, which makes lead frames for semiconductors, would post a 1996/97 parent current profit of 4.8 billion yen due to a rise in exports as a result of the weaker yen.
The company had forecast a parent current profit of 4.65 billion yen for 1996/97, compared with an actual parent current profit of 5.00 billion yen in 1995/96.
Mitsui High-tech spokespersons were not immediately available for comment.
